findings.reason: §4's done-when and §5's first three proofs would shrink from build-and-prove to verify-existing, and the effort estimate with them.
findings.text: §4 lists the batch-step topology, the 0700 runtime directory pointing XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and ZELLIJ_SOCKET_DIR at node-local /tmp, the session run as its own step, and step-end reaping as things derived from probes and to be proven built; reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py already implements every one of them (prepare_runtime at fleet_supervisor.py:262 sets the mode-0700 dir and both env vars; start_session at :1035 starts the zellij server; serve at :1277 is the batch-step reader) and bin/fleet-claude already runs the session as its own `srun --overlap --pty` step — the plan's "the launcher ... is not built" premise is stale

findings.reason: the author extends fleet_node.generate_hold_script (or adds nothing) rather than planning a parallel generator.
findings.text: §4 asks that the re-hold path "create the batch script that starts the zellij server", but reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:generate_hold_script already emits a batch step whose body execs fleet-supervisor (fleet_node.py:153-155), the re-hold is already owned by placement.ensure_reservation (placement.py:417), and fleet_node.submit is submission — a second script generator or a second hold path forks both owners

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no new module; the behaviour the plan hinges on is already hidden behind fleet_supervisor.py's four-verb FIFO, which is a small interface over the runtime directory, the zellij servers, the environment stripping and the sizing client.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the re-hold path the plan says "must create the batch script that starts the zellij server" is already owned by reckon/crew/fleet_node.py:generate_hold_script, which generates exactly that script and is reached by placement.ensure_reservation.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan proposes, as work to build and prove, the batch-step zellij launcher and its private runtime directory, which reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py already carries, and cites only the imas-ambix research note, never that module.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan proposes no thin layer over existing machinery; the login-side viewer it needs is already the existing bin/fleet-attach step, and the plan neither re-wraps nor re-implements it.
